question: When is the next meeting of the Pima County Board of Supervisors?

checks.claim: an Ask answer naming a meeting carries the Add to calendar control
checks.detail: mode GROUNDED_CLAUDE, subject ocd-division/country:us/state:az/county:pima#governing; 1 calendar block(s) with 2 control element(s). Before this the answer described the meeting and offered nothing to do with it, while the map card beside it offered both.

checks.claim: a day with two sittings offers a control for BOTH
checks.detail: 2 calendar offer(s) rendered. The Board sits at 1 p.m. and again at 5 p.m.; a reader given one entry for a two-sitting day gets the wrong afternoon half the time.

checks.claim: the Meetings pill opens the list FOCUSED on the answer's body, visibly and clearably
checks.detail: focus chip: "Only Pima County Board Of Supervisors · show all ✕". The pill used to dispatch a generic open with no subject, so a reader answered about one body got every meeting in the ZIP.

checks.claim: the focused list leads with that body and holds nothing else
checks.detail: 22 row(s) rendered; 0 name another body. Unfocused this sorted by date across all 149 meetings in the ZIP, so the answer's own body sat wherever the calendar put it.
